periods.time: After recovering enough to supervise the dojo
periods.label: 指导绚濑与藏人的最后武士
periods.affiliation: Ayatsuji dojo; Donrou Academy by association

status.current: healthy enough to teach and observe
status.condition: uses escaped prisoner Okuma as Ayase's practical training opportunity

relationships.ayase-ayatsuji: Daughter and student; he orders her to capture Okuma alone.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Disciple he teaches despite Kuraudo's violent nature, later pushing him to adapt Ayatsuji swordsmanship to his own brutality.
relationships.ginji-okuma: Old criminal he defeated and forgot, triggering Okuma's revenge attempt.

periods.summary: Kaito is targeted by escaped prisoner Ginji Okuma, a former yakuza Blazer whom he defeated fifteen years earlier and does not remember. He uses the situation to test Ayase, trusting her to capture the intruder. A later flashback shows Kaito visiting Kuraudo after the Seven Stars Festival and warning him not to become a mere Ayatsuji swordsman: Kuraudo should use Ayatsuji techniques as tools and pour his original violence into them, creating his own Ten'i Muhou.

key_events.summary: Lets Ayase handle Okuma rather than intervening.
His post-Seven-Stars advice explains Kuraudo's new fiery form of Ten'i Muhou.

periods.time: EDY breach of Tokyo's underground defense layer
periods.label: 病后重返战场的最后武士

status.condition: recently discharged but still skilled enough to cut EDY joints

relationships.ayase-ayatsuji: Daughter; joins the fight and kicks her out of the line of fire at his own risk.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Former dojo usurper whose later arrival saves Kaito and Ayase from EDY.

periods.summary: Kaito appears in the underground defense layer with a real sword despite being a non-Blazer and recently hospitalized. He corrects Ayase's tense sword form, uses Ayatsuji Ittou-ryuu technique to cut EDY units through their softer joints, and fights beside the students. When Ayase is injured and targeted by a hadron shot, Kaito kicks her away and exposes himself, only to be saved when Kuraudo arrives and destroys the EDY.

key_events.summary: Cuts EDY joints and saves Ayase before Kuraudo and the returning knights arrive.
